title: Equipment

fields.label: Default Sort Order
fields.notes: Numeric order for Default sorted Inventory; does not have to be unique.

fields.label: Found Flag
fields.notes: Index of the value proving you have found this item for the 100% Achievement.

fields.label: Unique
fields.notes: Cannot obtain more than 1 at a time; additional copies are automatically sold.

fields.label: Key
fields.notes: Cannot be sold, as it is important to the story.

fields.label: Disallow Auto-Generate
fields.notes: Cannot be used to fill units' non-specified equipment slots.

fields.label: Arc/Throw Flags
fields.notes: There was a lot more Thrown stuff back in LUCT, so this isn't much used so I'm not sure if this is a Type or Flag value.nIt may also be non-functional, as there was an additional Throwing-related Type/Flag field that has been overwritten in Reborn.

fields.label: Range Minimum
fields.notes: Value of 0 means you may target yourself.

fields.label: Range Maximum + 1
fields.notes: Value must be 1 greater than in-game value: 1=0, 2=1, 3=2, etc.

fields.label: Range Area (0,1 = 1)
fields.notes: Value of either 0 or 1 equal Area of 1.

fields.label: Battle Ability
fields.notes: Does the same thing as the old, now-unused Passive Skill field.

fields.label: Equipment Set
fields.notes: Equipping 3+ pieces of a set grants temporary acess to a Skill.

fields.label: Resist Earth Element
fields.notes: Because Element Resist is now Element "Strength", field names are rotated to show actual effect.nResist Air Element

fields.notes: Ignored for player's party in Reborn, but obeyed for auto-generated equipment.

fields.label: Equip Drop Chance
fields.notes: This might be /255 instead of /100.

fields.label: <unused> Craft Success Chance %
fields.notes: Crafting always succeeds in Reborn, so these fields are not used.

fields.notes: These fields were not used in LUCT, and Foreground seems yet-unimplemented.
